flora: Small Araucariaceae grove (stunted, symmetrical canopy, 'chunky' needles)
Zizyphus-like scrub forming an understory barrier
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the miniaturization; trees look mature and symmetrical but are significantly lower than a standard Araucaria.

visual_logic.composition: A scenic view of a river floodplain. A tight grove of small Araucariaceae trees frames the stream, their symmetrical, umbrella-shaped canopies visible. The overall scale of the trees feels relatable, like a garden, rather than towering.
visual_logic.ground: Rich, saturated red flood silt with a few river-worn stones.
visual_logic.lighting: Intense, high-key midday sun creating defined, but not aggressive, shadows.
